hero.title: Activities to book
hero.description: Experiences that need a reservation or tickets in advance. Day-by-day ideas are in the itinerary.

activities.title: Fu Hang Soy Milk (breakfast)
activities.description: The Taiwanese breakfast institution (2nd floor of Huashan Market). No booking: get there early, the queue is long.

activities.title: Turtle Island - whale watching & landing
activities.description: BOOKED (Klook YVS176209) - 2 adults, 1:00pm departure. Meet at 12:20pm on the 1st floor of the Lanyang Museum Wushi Station (Huaqi 168). About 4h. Island cleaning fee payable on site: NTD 100/adult. Passport required (coast guard check). Guiding in Chinese only.

activities.title: THSR early bird (day trips)
activities.description: Discounted THSR tickets 28 days ahead for the Taipei and Taichung days.
